answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 8189 Country: India Title: My questions are as following 1)Can Nawafil Nimaz be offered between Sunnah Nimaz and Farz Nimaz? 2)Can Nawafil Nimaz be offered after Farz Nimaz? 3)In a Farz Nimaz,is it obligatory for a Imam Sahib to sit after Salam and read zikrs like Ayatul Kursi and Tasbihat etc.? 4)After a Farz Nimaz, is it necessary that a Imam Sahib should offer duas? Question: Aslaam U Alaikum Wa Rehmatullahi Wa Barakatahu Respected Ulemas My questions are as following 1)Can Nawafil Nimaz be offered between Sunnah Nimaz and Farz Nimaz? 2)Can Nawafil Nimaz be offered after Farz Nimaz? 3)In a Farz Nimaz,is it obligatory for a Imam Sahib to sit after Salam and read zikrs like Ayatul Kursi and Tasbihat etc.? 4)After a Farz Nimaz, is it necessary that a Imam Sahib should offer duas? KHUDA HAFIZ Answer ID: 8189 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2511/321=B/1429) (1) Yes, it can be offered, but it not better. (2) Yes, it can be offered except after Fajr and Zuhr prayers. (3) It is not necessary; he may go or may recite dua and Ayatul Kursi as per his wishes. (4) It is desirable ( mustahab ) not necessary, one should leave it occasionally. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
